name: Kuramei Sprint 4 — Produção + Scheduler + Novos Experience Packages
description: Produto em produção com primeiro usuário real + lembretes que disparam + dois novos Experience Packages. Critério: Alexandre envia lembrete via WhatsApp real e recebe notificação no horário.

userStories.title: @kuramei/kv-client — eliminar duplicação de lógica KV
userStories.description: Tech debt: extrair lógica de acesso ao Cloudflare KV para pacote compartilhado.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/kv-client/ with package.json (name: @kuramei/kv-client, version: 0.1.0), tsconfig.json
Create src/index.ts exporting: put(key: string, value: string, ttlSeconds: number): Promise<void>, get(key: string): Promise<string | null>, del(key: string): Promise<void>
Implementation uses Cloudflare KV REST API: https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/storage/kv/namespaces/{CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID}/values/{key}
Config via env vars: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
Update packages/sdk/src/generate-ui-helper.ts to use @kuramei/kv-client instead of inline fetch
Update packages/tools/src/builtin/generate-ui.ts to use @kuramei/kv-client instead of inline fetch
Update apps/ui-worker/src/index.ts: keep KV binding (wrangler) for reading — Worker uses native KV binding, not the REST client
Remove duplicate KV fetch logic from both generate-ui.ts and generate-ui-helper.ts
Add packages/kv-client/* to pnpm-workspace.yaml (verify glob covers it)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
userStories.notes: NOTE: ui-worker READS from KV via Wrangler native binding (env.KV.get) — this does NOT use @kuramei/kv-client. Only Lambda-side code (generate-ui-helper, generate-ui tool) uses the REST client.

userStories.title: Deploy produção — IaC + runbook (gerado por Ralph, executado por Alexandre)
userStories.description: Gerar toda a infraestrutura como código e runbook passo a passo para Alexandre executar o primeiro deploy real.
acceptanceCriteria: IMPORTANT: Ralph generates IaC and runbook. Alexandre executes manually. Do NOT attempt to run aws, cdk deploy, wrangler deploy, or any cloud CLI commands.

Create infra/cdk/ with: package.json, tsconfig.json, bin/kuramei.ts (CDK app entry), lib/webhook-stack.ts (Lambda webhook-handler + API GW), lib/agent-stack.ts (Lambda agent-processor), lib/scheduler-stack.ts (Lambda reminder-scheduler + EventBridge rule), lib/dynamo-stack.ts (kuramei-main and kuramei-reminders tables with GSI)
Lambda configs: runtime Node.js 20, architecture arm64, timeout 30s (webhook), 60s (agent), 5m (scheduler)
DynamoDB kuramei-reminders table: PAY_PER_REQUEST, PK=PK (String), SK=SK (String), GSI status-when-index: PK=status (String), SK=when (String)
Create apps/ui-worker/wrangler.toml with: name=kuramei-ui, main=src/index.ts, compatibility_date, kv_namespaces binding, routes for kuramei.app/* (or app.kuramei.app/*)

Create docs/runbook-deploy.md with step-by-step instructions for Alexandre: (1) AWS prerequisites (credentials, CDK bootstrap), (2) pnpm install in infra/cdk, (3) cdk deploy --all, (4) set secrets in Secrets Manager, (5) wrangler secret put KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET, (6) wrangler deploy in apps/ui-worker, (7) Meta webhook config, (8) smoke test against prod
Create .env.production.example with all required env vars for Lambda (no values, just keys)
pnpm build passes (infra/cdk compiles without errors)
userStories.notes: This US delivers IaC + documentation only. Alexandre runs the actual deployment. Mark passes:true when runbook + CDK code compile and docs are complete.

userStories.title: Correção arquitetural — tool descriptions ricas, systemPromptSections como contratos
userStories.description: Reescrever tool descriptions para assumir roteamento LLM. Reduzir systemPromptSections a contratos comportamentais.
acceptanceCriteria: Update packages/tools/src/builtin/generate-ui.ts tool description to be rich and cover all use cases: navigation/map/location, confirmation/message, structured lists. Include parameter examples per type.

New generate_ui description must cover: 'for any location, map, navigation, or route request', 'for confirmations and summaries', 'for structured lists'. Params: type 'navigation' (destination: string, departureTime?, avoidTolls?, preferredApp?), type 'message' (title, body, actions?), type 'list' (title, items[]).

Update packages/experiences/navigation/src/index.ts: remove routing instructions from systemPromptSection. New systemPromptSection must ONLY contain: 'Após chamar generate_ui, responder sempre com texto contextual amigável em PT-BR além do link. Nunca enviar só a URL sem contexto.'

Update packages/experiences/reminder/src/index.ts create_reminder tool description to be rich: cover linguistic variations ('me lembra de X', 'lembra eu de Y às Z', 'não me deixa esquecer de W'). State clearly that when is required and model must ask if missing.

Update packages/experiences/reminder/src/index.ts systemPromptSection to ONLY contain behavioral contracts: 'Se when não especificado, perguntar em uma única mensagem antes de chamar create_reminder. Nunca criar sem when. Não listar no mesmo turn que criar.'
pnpm build passes
pnpm lint passes
userStories.notes: Key rule: tool descriptions = router. systemPromptSection = behavioral contracts only.

userStories.title: list_reminders — visualizar lembretes pendentes
userStories.description: Adicionar capacidade de listar lembretes ao experience-reminder.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tool list_reminders to packages/experiences/reminder/src/index.ts
list_reminders Zod input schema: { filter: z.enum(['today', 'upcoming', 'all']).default('upcoming') }
list_reminders handler: query DynamoDB table REMINDERS_TABLE where PK='USER#<userId>' using FilterExpression status = 'pending', sort results by when ascending
If filter='today': filter items where when starts with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD in ISO string)
If non-empty result: call generateUI() with ListSpec: { type: 'list', title: 'Seus lembretes ⏰', items: reminder.map(r => ({ label: r.text, description: formatWhenPtBr(r.when) })) }
If empty result: call generateUI() with MessageSpec: { type: 'message', title: 'Nenhum lembrete pendente', body: 'Você está em dia! ✅', actions: [] }

list_reminders tool description: 'Lists the user's pending reminders as a visual page. Use when the user asks about their reminders, schedule, or what they have coming up. Filter: today for today only, upcoming for all future (default), all for everything.'
Add to systemPromptSection (as additional contract, not replacing existing): 'Não listar reminders logo após criar um no mesmo turn — aguardar próxima interação do usuário.'
reminderExperience.tools updated to include list_reminders
pnpm build passes
pnpm typecheck passes
userStories.notes: formatWhenPtBr: simple ISO-to-PT-BR format (e.g. '2026-02-24T20:00:00-03:00' → 'Amanhã às 20:00'). No external date lib — use Intl.DateTimeFormat.

userStories.title: Experience Package Clima (@kuramei/experience-weather)
userStories.description: Terceiro Experience Package — consulta de tempo via wttr.in (sem API key).
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/experiences/weather/ with package.json (name: @kuramei/experience-weather, version: 0.1.0), tsconfig.json, src/index.ts
Tool get_weather with Zod input: { location: z.string().min(1) }
Implementation: fetch('https://wttr.in/{encodeURIComponent(location)}?format=j1') — free, no API key
Extract from response: current.temp_C, current.weatherDesc[0].value, current.FeelsLikeC, weather[0].maxtempC, weather[0].mintempC

On success: call generateUI() with MessageSpec: { type: 'message', title: '🌤️ Tempo em {location}', body: '{condition} • {temp}°C (sensação {feels_like}°C)\nMáx {max}°C / Mín {min}°C hoje', actions: [] }
On fetch error or location not found: call generateUI() with MessageSpec with friendly PT-BR error

get_weather tool description: 'Gets current weather and today\'s forecast for any city. Use for any question about weather, temperature, rain, or climate — como está o tempo em X, vai chover em Y, que roupa usar em Z, temperatura de W. Requires location name.'
weatherExperience.systemPromptSection: 'Após retornar clima, adicionar dica contextual amigável em PT-BR se relevante (ex: leve guarda-chuva! se vai chover).'
Export weatherExperience: ExperiencePackage from src/index.ts
Update apps/agent-processor/src/index.ts to import and load weatherExperience
pnpm build passes
pnpm typecheck passes
userStories.notes: wttr.in returns JSON with nested structure. Handle gracefully if API is slow or returns unexpected shape.

userStories.title: Experience Package Cotação (@kuramei/experience-currency)
userStories.description: Quarto Experience Package — conversão de moeda via open.er-api.com (sem API key).
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/experiences/currency/ with package.json (name: @kuramei/experience-currency, version: 0.1.0), tsconfig.json, src/index.ts
Tool convert_currency with Zod input: { amount: z.number().positive(), from: z.string().length(3).toUpperCase(), to: z.string().length(3).toUpperCase() }
Implementation: fetch('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/{from}') — free tier, no API key required
Calculate result = amount * rates[to], format to 2 decimal places
On success: call generateUI() with MessageSpec: { type: 'message', title: '💱 {amount} {from} = {result} {to}', body: 'Taxa: 1 {from} = {rate:.4f} {to}\nAtualizado em: {date}', actions: [] }
On invalid currency (rate not found): call generateUI() with MessageSpec listing main supported currencies (USD, EUR, BRL, GBP, JPY, ARS, CLP, COP, MXN)
On fetch error: friendly PT-BR error MessageSpec

convert_currency tool description: 'Converts currency amounts using real-time exchange rates. Use for any currency conversion question — quanto é X dólares em reais, converte Y euros para BRL, quanto é Z libras, cotação do dólar hoje. Infer from/to currencies from context; default to BRL if destination not specified.'
currencyExperience.systemPromptSection: 'Ao responder cotação, adicionar contexto se relevante (ex: taxa de hoje às {hora}).'
Export currencyExperience: ExperiencePackage from src/index.ts
Update apps/agent-processor/src/index.ts to import and load currencyExperience
pnpm build passes
pnpm typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Currencies are 3-letter ISO codes (USD, BRL, EUR etc). Validate input and give helpful error if user passes something unexpected.

userStories.title: Reminder Scheduler — lembretes que disparam no horário
userStories.description: Lambda que roda a cada minuto, verifica lembretes vencidos, envia WhatsApp e atualiza status.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/reminder-scheduler/ with package.json (@kuramei/reminder-scheduler), tsconfig.json, src/index.ts
Lambda handler: triggered by EventBridge rule rate(1 minute)

Query DynamoDB kuramei-reminders using GSI status-when-index: KeyConditionExpression = 'status = :pending AND #when <= :now', ExpressionAttributeNames = { '#when': 'when' }, ExpressionAttributeValues = { ':pending': 'pending', ':now': new Date().toISOString() }, Limit: 25
For each triggered reminder: send WhatsApp message via TenantBoundSender (from @kuramei/whatsapp): '⏰ Lembrete: *{text}*'
After sending: update DynamoDB item status → 'triggered', add triggeredAt = new Date().toISOString()

Phone number lookup: reminder item must store phoneNumber (add phoneNumber field to create_reminder DynamoDB write in US-003 handler — update create_reminder to store phoneNumber from context.userId which is the hashed phone — NOTE: need raw phoneNumber stored separately, add rawPhone field to DynamoDB item using context.userId before hashing if available, or store userId as phone directly)
Error handling: if WhatsApp send fails, log error but still update status to 'failed' (not 'triggered') and add failedAt
IMPORTANT: EventBridge Scheduler (cron) is DIFFERENT from EventBridge for async messaging (which is vetoed). A simple rate(1 minute) rule for a scheduler is acceptable.
pnpm build passes
pnpm typecheck passes
Add reminder-scheduler Lambda config to infra/cdk/lib/scheduler-stack.ts (update the stack created in US-002)
userStories.notes: BLOCKER: phone number must be stored in reminder DynamoDB item (not just hashed userId). Coordinate with create_reminder handler in US-003 to store rawPhone or phoneNumber directly. If context.userId is the WhatsApp phone number, store it directly.
